newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ wholesale electricity prices rise in Feb - EMCO.
newsitem.headline: NZ wholesale electricity prices rise in Feb - EMCO.

text.p: Average wholesale New Zealand electricity prices in February rose in both the North and South Islands compared with January prices, electricity market operator EMCO said on Wednesday.
The average wholesale electricity price for the South Island (at the Benmore reference point) in February was 4.60 cents per kilowatt hour compared with 3.17 cents in January.
In the North Island (at the Haywards reference point), the average price was 4.96 cents a kilowatt hour, up from 4.10 cents in January.
The prices compared to December's 2.62 cents (South Island) and 3.64 cents (North Island).
The highest South Island price in February was 6.08 cents (4.52 cents in January) and the lowest price was 3.67 cents (1.95 cents in January).
The highest North Island price in February was 13.67 cents compared with 13.77 cents in Janaury. The lowest price was 4.20 cents compared with 2.11 cents in January.
EMCO said final prices for March were due to be published on or before April 10.
